one_line: A disciplined lawyer-organizer leading the Champaran satyagraha to investigate indigo abuses and negotiate legal reform.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s, very lean and slight build, with a modest, almost fragile physical presence but steady posture.
appearance.face: Narrow oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown complexion, thin neatly trimmed moustache, small rounded nose, faint lines around mouth and eyes; default expression is gentle but intent, with calm, observant eyes behind round glasses.
appearance.hair: Very closely cropped, thinning black hair with visible receding hairline, appearing almost shaved; no headwear.
appearance.costume: Simple knee-length off-white khadi kurta with a straight collar and long sleeves, worn over plain off-white dhoti wrapped to mid-calf, a handwoven light-beige khadi shawl draped firmly around his shoulders and across the chest, all in slightly textured, un-dyed homespun cotton; on his feet, basic brown leather sandals with a single strap; he sometimes keeps the shawl pulled tighter in front when walking.
appearance.signature: A plain wooden walking stick about chest-high with a slightly darker, rounded handle, always held in one hand or used as support when he walks.

ref_desc: A very lean late-40s Mahatma Gandhi with narrow oval brown face, thin moustache, round glasses, almost shaved thinning hair, wearing off-white khadi kurta and mid-calf dhoti with a light-beige shawl and brown sandals, holding a plain wooden walking stick.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Mahatma Gandhi in 1917 Champaran: a very lean, slight man in his late 40s with a narrow oval medium-brown face, high cheekbones, thin neatly trimmed moustache, calm observant eyes behind small round metal-rimmed spectacles, and very closely cropped thinning black hair with a receding hairline that looks almost shaved. He wears a simple, modest, knee-length off-white khadi kurta with a straight collar and long sleeves over a plain off-white dhoti wrapped to mid-calf, both in slightly textured, un-dyed homespun cotton, with a light-beige khadi shawl draped firmly around his shoulders and across his chest, sometimes gathered closer at the front. On his feet are basic brown leather sandals with a single strap across the foot. Show him holding a plain wooden walking stick about chest-high with a slightly darker rounded handle, which he lightly leans on or carries at his side. Use an understated earthy palette of off-white, light beige, and medium to dark browns, and present him in multiple poses and angles (front, side, three-quarter) that emphasize his calm, disciplined presence and simple, historically accurate clothing.
